title: EclipseSMP Utilities
description: Utility mod from EclipseSMP. Works with AMTAE
body:
# Content Additions
## Recipes Changes
- Tridents can be smelt down into Hearts of the Sea
- Guarding Netherite Sheilds can be crafted
- Bundles can be crafted using leather and string.
## A Means to an End Addtions
- End Sickness gets applied when you join the world for the first time.
## EclipseSMP Special Content
### Eclipse Cookie
- Fullills your entire hunger bar
- Was given out to players after completing a challange advancement (Wasnt Coded)
- Given via commands
### Call of the Night (Nightfall Exclusive)
- Special Advancement that was given during a special event (Given via commands)
